x-contract.reason_vs_fetch_error: separate channels: reason covers data availability, fetch_error covers widget-fetch failures carried in an otherwise-served snapshot; both can be null
x-contract.failure_shape: typed tool results carrying status/reason/remedy - NEVER MCP protocol errors, never isError:true

affordances.description: MCP tool get_usage: Claude subscription quota headroom from the widget's snapshot, plus local CC burn SINCE that snapshot's captured_at (consented roots only; null when nothing consented). Server computes age_seconds/resets_in_seconds; reset-crossed tiers serve utilization null, never the stale percent. Pace derivations (cooldown/surplus/projected-final) are anchored AT CALL TIME - as of now, not as of the snapshot. status ok|stale|no_data with reason+remedy; widget fetch failures surface as fetch_error with last-good tiers (reason stays null - separate channels). account carries a hashed ref plus plan; plan is a tier name (e.g. 'Max 20x'), not an identity label. Data class: usage-metrics.

output.shape: status, reason, remedy, fetch_error, as_of, age_seconds, scope:'active_account_only', account{ref,plan}, data_lag_note, schema_version, tiers[{key,label,utilization_pct,headroom_pct,resets_at,resets_in_seconds,reset_crossed,pace{verdict,delta_pct,cooldown_seconds|null,surplus_pct|null,projected_final_pct|null}|null,projection{expires_before_reset,expires_in_seconds}|null,used,limit}], local_burn_since_snapshot{total_tokens,by_tier,caveat}|null. Pacing depth (abilities wave): cooldown_seconds = idle time to fall back onto pace when ahead; surplus_pct = banked headroom when under; projected_final_pct = where the meter lands at reset on current momentum, capped 200

affordances.authDetail: none-local-ambient: stdio child of the user's own CLI; ambient user authority. A token here would be theater - any local process can read snapshot.json directly.

verified.detail: Run 1 (af4bba22938cc9f2a): 7 snapshot states typed correctly, isError never set, burn anchor proven = captured_at. Run 2 delta: pacing depth proven - ahead/under verdicts, cooldown identity (10800 - age), surplus, projected-final 200 cap, pre-existing pace fields regression-checked; pace anchor confirmed call-time.

affordances.description: MCP tool get_local_burn_by_project: attribute recent local CC token burn to projects, keyed PER Claude Code home (the tenant wall - results never merge homes). Params are a closed set: window_days enum 1|7|30, full_paths bool (basenames by default). Zero consented roots -> no_data/disabled; invalid window -> no_data/invalid_params (typed, never a protocol error). Every ok response echoes window_days/since/full_paths and names roots_scanned. Data class: local-fs-paths, cross-tenant-risk. Attribution only - token counts are a proxy, never convertible to quota %.

output.shape: status, reason, remedy, window_days, since, full_paths, roots_scanned[], roots[{root,total_tokens,projects[{name,tokens}]}], files_scanned, caveat

affordances.authDetail: none-local-ambient + consent map: reads only CC homes flagged true in %APPDATA%/Sanduhr/settings.json mcp_roots (absent = nothing consented, fail closed). No free-form paths - the file-oracle guard.

verified.detail: Cold-agent pass: per-root keying held; basenames by default (full fixture path absent from response); full_paths opt-in worked; window filter correct at 1/7; window 3 rejected as typed invalid_params; no-consent path returned disabled with remedy.

affordances.description: MCP tool ping: health + verify anchor. server_version, snapshot schema supported, snapshot path/presence/age, CC roots found vs consented. cc_roots_found is the machine's discovery scan of well-known homes; cc_roots_consented reflects the active consent source (settings map, or the dev env override when set) - the two lists can disagree by design. Distinguishes server-broken from data-absent; call it first when get_usage returns no_data.

output.shape: server_version, snapshot_schema_supported, snapshot_path, snapshot_found, snapshot_age_seconds, cc_roots_found[], cc_roots_consented[]

verified.detail: Cold-agent pass: snapshot_found/age/path all matched the env-selected fixture; consented reflected the override while found reported the real machine scan.

affordances.description: MCP tool get_model_usage: per-model local CC token totals over a closed window (1|7|30 days) across consented roots, each model joined with its weekly meter utilization from the live snapshot (meter_source carries the snapshot's own status/age so meter freshness is never implied). Unmapped models stay visible with tier null. The 'which model for this job' answer in one call. Data class: usage-metrics.

output.shape: status, window_days, since, roots_scanned[], total_tokens, models[{model,tokens,share_pct,tier_key|null,tier_label|null,meter_utilization_pct|null}], meter_source{status,as_of,age_seconds}|null, caveat

verified.detail: Delta cold verify: totals/ranking/share exact (3100; fable 3000/97%), tier mapping + meter join proven (crafted fable-tier snapshot served 57), unmapped model visible with null tier, meter_source carries snapshot status/age, missing-snapshot path serves tokens with null meters, typed invalid_params, disabled path fail-closed.

affordances.description: MCP tool get_usage_history: daily local CC usage from Sanduhr's durable vault (survives Claude Code's ~30-day log cleanup) over 7|30|90 days across consented roots: per-day tokens with sent/received split, window totals, top-5 projects (display names only - vault keys are name~hash and the hash never leaves). Days without a record are OMITTED, never fabricated as zero (a widget-off week must not read as a vacation). Vault reads only - the server has no vault write path by tool construction. Data class: usage-metrics, local-fs-derived.

output.shape: status, window_days, from, to, roots_scanned[], total_tokens, days_recorded, days[{date,tokens,sent,received}], top_projects[{name,tokens}], caveat

affordances.authDetail: none-local-ambient + mcp_roots consent map (fail closed). Vault dir env-overridable dev-tier only (SANDUHR_VAULT_DIR).

verified.detail: Delta cold verify: totals + sent/received split exact, gap day OMITTED (no fabricated zero), project display names only (~hash suffix absent from the entire response), typed invalid_params, disabled fail-closed (checked before vault), empty vault -> missing with vault remedy.

affordances.description: The rendezvous artifact itself: %APPDATA%/Sanduhr/snapshot.json, schema v1. One writer (the widget, atomic temp+swap each 5-min fetch while the statusline integration is on), N read-only consumers. Raw facts only - no precomputed pace/countdowns. account_ref is a SHA-256 prefix, never the label. Deleted on account switch, sign-out, and integration removal - consumers treat missing as no-data, never cache last-known-good.

output.shape: schema_version, writer_version, captured_at, account_ref, plan, status ok|error, error_kind, tiers[]

affordances.authDetail: none-local-ambient: user-profile file ACLs are the boundary.

verified.detail: Cold-agent pass: parses per documented shape; account_ref matches ^[0-9a-f]{8}$; no readable identity anywhere in the file.

affordances.description: Claude Code statusline render: PS 5.1-compatible script at %APPDATA%/Sanduhr/bin/sanduhr-statusline.ps1, spawned per prompt by Claude Code. Staleness bands mirror SnapshotContract: fresh <450s renders numbers; stale <=900s renders numbers + age marker; dead REPLACES the numbers with an explicit 'start widget' line (never blank); missing = empty output, the uninstalled look. ASCII-only output by contract (PowerShell redirect encoding vs UTF-8 consumers). The widget is the script's update channel.

verified.detail: Cold-agent pass: fresh/stale/dead/missing all rendered per the band table; raw-byte capture confirmed pure ASCII in every scenario.
